name: @andrewpopov/release-kit
description: Reusable release/patch-note toolkit: alpha-semver versioning, fragment-based patch notes, release cut/publish/validate, and release-hygiene enforcement. Consumers inject all policy (paths, kinds, wording) via a small config.
author: Andrew Popov

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:pack && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
